clue.text: Quiet helpers at Christmas making furniture

definitions.note: shelves as a collective item of furniture

parts.note: SH is the hushing word asking for quiet
elves are Santa's helpers in his workshop

explanation.surface: Santa's little helpers keep quiet while building furniture in the workshop.
explanation.definitionFit: Shelves are fitted or free-standing storage pieces counted among household furnishings.

clue.text: Quickly read covers of philosophy revealing a lot

parts.note: to skim is to read fast and superficially

indicators.note: the covers of a book are its outside, so the word's outer letters are taken

parts.note: first and last letters of philosophy

explanation.surface: Speed-reading the jacket of a philosophy book tells you a great deal.
explanation.definitionFit: Skimpy clothing is scanty and shows much of the body, so it reveals plenty.

clue.text: Recruit this person, turning up with cunning plan

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word is read bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: the setter refers to themselves as this person, hence me
a ploy is a crafty scheme

explanation.surface: A job candidate arrives with a scheme to get themselves hired.
explanation.definitionFit: To employ someone is to take them on as staff, which is what recruiting does.

clue.text: Wicked holiday home across the Atlantic with nothing in

parts.note: a villa is a house rented for a holiday

indicators.note: in says one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: seen from Britain, across the Atlantic is in the US
O is the shape of zero, nothing

explanation.surface: An American holiday house that is wickedly empty.
explanation.definitionFit: Villainous describes conduct befitting a villain: evil, criminal or morally bad.

clue.text: Mexican food — it's a shame to eat seconds up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read from the bottom, backwards
eating means taking something inside, so one piece swallows the other

parts.note: alas is an exclamation of regret, it's a shame

explanation.surface: Regret at having to eat second helpings at a Mexican meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Salsa is a spicy Mexican sauce of tomatoes, onions and chillies served with food.

clue.text: Call off a finale from Wagner resembling The Ring

parts.note: to annul is to cancel or call off

indicators.note: the finale of a word is its closing letter, taken here from Wagner

parts.note: last letter of Wagner

explanation.surface: Cancelling the grand finale of Wagner's Ring cycle at the opera house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Ring' looks like Wagner's opera cycle, which the surface leans on, but the definition is simply 'ring-shaped'.
explanation.definitionFit: Annular is the adjective for anything shaped like a circular band, from the Latin for little ring.

clue.text: Legal document settled a tiff David ultimately lost

indicators.note: settled suggests something put into a new order, hence rearranged
the closing letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: David with its last letter removed

explanation.surface: A quarrel resolved after David lost in the end, now on official paperwork.
explanation.definitionFit: An affidavit is a written statement sworn under oath for use as evidence in court.

clue.text: Invalid, flipping unwell, unhappy to some extent

indicators.note: flipping turns the letters over, reading them backwards
only part of the words is used, so the letters are concealed within them

parts.note: the letters straddle the end of unwell and start of unhappy

explanation.surface: An invalid who is ill and rather miserable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Invalid' suggests a sick person, matching unwell, but it is the adjective: not valid.
explanation.definitionFit: Null and void means having no legal force, a synonym of invalid.

clue.text: Underwear I removed with diamonds hung around

indicators.note: removed means the following letter is taken out

parts.note: lingerie is women's underwear
D is the card-suit abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: A woman takes off her underwear, keeping on her diamonds.
explanation.definitionFit: Lingered means stayed on, loitering longer than needed, the same as hung about.

clue.text: Unfortunately, true love's not very steadfast

indicators.note: something gone wrong is in disarray, so the letters are rearranged
not marks a letter that is left out of the mix

explanation.surface: Sadly, true love is not particularly constant.
explanation.definitionFit: Resolute means firmly determined and unwavering, sharing the sense of loyal constancy.

clue.text: Mischief-maker with the Spanish press

parts.note: an imp is a small mischievous sprite
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A prankster teams up with the Spanish newspapers.
explanation.definitionFit: To impel someone is to urge or drive them on, the verb sense of press.

clue.text: Ropes in fifty-one cats

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty and I for one
felines are members of the cat family

explanation.surface: Fifty-one cats tangled up in ropes, a picture of a chaotic barn.
explanation.definitionFit: Lifelines are the safety ropes thrown or rigged to save people from falling or drowning.

clue.text: Support African country changing leader in political advertising

parts.note: a prop holds something up

indicators.note: the country's first letter is swapped for another, here an A

parts.note: Uganda is a country in East Africa

explanation.surface: Backing an African state with a change of leadership, the stuff of state-sponsored campaigns.
explanation.definitionFit: Propaganda is biased information spread to promote a political cause or point of view.

clue.text: Give people a hand with cases for departure and arrival

indicators.note: the cases of a word are its outside letters, enclosing it like a box

parts.note: first and last letters of departure
first and last letters of arrival

explanation.surface: A porter helps travellers with their suitcases as they come and go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Give people a hand' sounds like helping, but in card games it means distributing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: To deal is to distribute cards to players, so each person receives a hand.

clue.text: Keen on country, in a manner of speaking

parts.note: to be into something is to be enthusiastic about it
a nation is a country

explanation.surface: A patriot speaking passionately about their homeland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In a manner of speaking' looks like a stock phrase, but 'manner of speaking' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Intonation is the rise and fall of the voice, the tune or way in which words are spoken.

clue.text: Where sisters live, housing that is new and uncomfortable

indicators.note: one piece holds the other inside it, as a house holds its occupants

parts.note: nuns, called sisters, live in a convent
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: Nuns finding their convent's new arrangement rather awkward.
explanation.definitionFit: Inconvenient means causing trouble or discomfort, awkward for those involved.

clue.text: Group rowing in a newsroom after editing

indicators.note: editing changes text around, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A team of journalists squabbling in a newsroom after an editing session.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rowing' suggests arguing, which fits a newsroom, but it means propelling boats.
explanation.definitionFit: Oarswomen are female rowers, a crew who propel a boat with oars.

clue.text: People who aren't pro Republican in Team USA, curiously

indicators.note: curiously suggests an odd arrangement, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A Republican oddly on the US national team, though not a professional.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pro' reads as in favour of, but means professional.
explanation.definitionFit: Amateurs take part in sport or activity without pay, as opposed to professionals.

clue.text: Co-operate with entertainment on stage and dance

parts.note: a play is a theatrical performance
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Joining in with a stage show and a dance.
explanation.definitionFit: To play ball is an idiom meaning to go along with others and work together.

clue.text: Problem with poor fare, travelling to Milan and Turin

indicators.note: letters on the move end up in fresh positions, signalling rearrangement

explanation.surface: Bad food on a trip between two Italian cities.
explanation.definitionFit: Malnutrition is the condition caused by an inadequate or unbalanced diet.

clue.text: Cricket side cheers up over smooth style of playing

parts.note: the leg side is one half of a cricket field

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read backwards

parts.note: ta is British slang for thanks, cheers
O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A cricket team celebrating over and over.
explanation.definitionFit: Legato is a musical direction for notes played smoothly and connected without breaks.

clue.text: Like a seabird in the back of a ship

definitions.text: in the back of a ship

parts.note: as means like, in comparison
a tern is a seabird

explanation.surface: A gull-like bird perched at the stern of a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Astern is the nautical term for at or toward the rear part of a vessel.

clue.text: Characters opening teashop obtain yummy, sweet trifles

indicators.note: the letters that open each following word are taken

parts.note: first letter of teashop
first letter of obtain
first letter of yummy
first letter of sweet

explanation.surface: At a teashop, getting a delicious sweet trifle for dessert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trifles' tempts as the dessert, but here it is a verb: to toy with is to trifle.
explanation.definitionFit: To toy with something is to handle it idly or not seriously, which is what one does who trifles.

clue.text: Small vehicles with sweet, roast nuts

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A snack of sweet roasted nuts.
explanation.definitionFit: Two-seaters are compact cars or aircraft with room for only a driver and one passenger.

clue.text: Turf extremists out of home in sinful city

parts.note: a sod is a piece of turf

indicators.note: the extreme letters at each end are thrown out

parts.note: home without its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Turfing radicals out of their homes in a den of iniquity.
explanation.definitionFit: Sodom is the biblical city destroyed for its wickedness, a byword for vice.

clue.text: Marx Brother wants nothing smart

indicators.note: wants means lacks, so the letter is missing

parts.note: Chico was one of the Marx Brothers comedy team
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A Marx Brother who desires nothing smart.
explanation.definitionFit: Chic means stylish and elegant, as in a smart outfit.

clue.text: Run a sham editorial, somewhat brazen

indicators.note: somewhat says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Telling a newspaper to publish a fake leader article, and shamelessly so.
explanation.definitionFit: Brazen and unashamed both describe someone bold and without any sense of embarrassment.

clue.text: Boiling innkeeper's coat put away

indicators.note: a coat is the outer layer, so only the word's outside letters are kept

parts.note: innkeeper, whose first and last letters form the coat
to put away food is to eat it

explanation.surface: An angry innkeeper's coat has been put away.
explanation.definitionFit: Boiling here is the figurative sense of seething with anger, hence furious.

clue.text: Oddly, skill shown by star, one making chips?

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters of the next word are kept

parts.note: first, third and fifth letters of skill
a star or celebrity is an icon

explanation.surface: A star chef showing off his skill making chips.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that the chips are computer chips, not fried potatoes.
explanation.definitionFit: Silicon is the semiconductor element from which microchips are manufactured.

clue.text: Weekend nearly over? It's very wet weather

parts.note: Monday, abbreviated Mon, is what the weekend's end brings
something nearly over will finish soon

explanation.surface: Sunday evening gloom as heavy rain sets in.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole question reads as 'Mon soon': with the weekend nearly over, Monday is coming. 'It's' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A monsoon is the seasonal rainy period of South Asia, with torrential downpours.
